description: This file defines a React component for rendering a comprehensive report view in a Playwright test report application. It manages routing, filtering, and displaying test files, test cases, and a speedboard feature, including user interaction handling and dynamic data loading.

classes.name: TestCaseViewLoader
classes.description: A React component responsible for asynchronously loading and displaying a specific test case or test result, including navigation to previous/next tests.

methods.name: computeStats
methods.description: Calculates aggregated statistics from test files based on applied filters.

methods.name: createFilesModel
methods.description: Creates a model representing filtered and grouped test files and their tests.

methods.name: createMergedFilesModel
methods.description: Creates a merged view of test files grouped by test description, combining tests with the same description across files.

methods.name: createSpeedboardFilesModel
methods.description: Creates a model for the speedboard view, sorting tests by duration.
